verdict.rationale: HubSpot supports data export via its import/export tools and CRM APIs (contacts, custom objects) allowing users to extract their data, but exports are in HubSpot's proprietary CRM structures/CSV rather than a fully open, standardized format, and there's no evidence of a comprehensive full-account export or portability guarantee for leaving the platform. No llms.txt/openapi discovery endpoints were found, undercutting 'AI-native' self-serve openness claims.
